movelist.name: Poison Sting
movelist.effect: Poison Sting Poisons the target on 17+.

movelist.name: Constrict
movelist.effect: Constrict lowers the target’s Speed 1 Combat Stage. Constrict may be used as a Swift Action against targets the user is Grappling, and automatically hits when performed this way.

movelist.name: String Shot
movelist.effect: Targets have their Speed CS lowered by -1. If this lowers their Speed CS to -6, or if their Speed CS was already at -6, the target is instead Stuck.

movelist.name: Leech Life
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains HP equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

movelist.name: Scary Face
movelist.effect: The target’s Speed is lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Night Shade
movelist.effect: The target loses Hit Points equal to the level of Night Shade’s user. Do not apply weakness or resistance. Do not apply stats.

abilities.name: Insomnia
abilities.effect: The user is immune to the Sleep condition, and cannot use the move Rest. Defensive.

abilities.name: Silk Threads
abilities.effect: Connection - String Shot. Whenever the user uses String Shot, all targets hit become Slowed and Vulnerable for 1 full round.
